note: Seeded into a GitHub repo as Issues by seed_lab.py. The expected_kb, expected_outcome and why fields are for the playbook and are NOT sent to GitHub.

tickets.title: Cannot log in, account says locked
tickets.body: I typed my password wrong a few times this morning and now it says my account is locked. I need to get back in before my 10am call.
tickets.why: Textbook deflection. Unambiguous wording, exact KB match.

tickets.title: Forgot my password
tickets.body: I have forgotten my WEWIN password and need to reset it. I am working from home today so I cannot come to the service desk.
tickets.why: Same article, different wording. Proves semantic match, not keyword.

tickets.title: Password expired overnight
tickets.body: Logged in this morning and it told me my password expired. The reset link in the email does not seem to work.
tickets.why: Third wording for the same article. Three is enough to show a pattern.

tickets.title: VPN will not connect from home
tickets.body: The VPN client spins for about thirty seconds and then says it cannot reach the gateway. It worked fine in the office yesterday.
tickets.why: Clean deflection on a second article.

tickets.title: How do I get on the VPN on a new laptop
tickets.body: I picked up my replacement laptop and there is no VPN client on it. What do I need to install and where do I get the config?
tickets.why: Deflects, and also shows the KB covering a setup question.

tickets.title: Outlook stopped syncing
tickets.body: My email has not updated since yesterday afternoon. Outlook says Disconnected in the bottom corner. Webmail works fine.
tickets.why: Clean deflection on a third article.

tickets.title: Not receiving any new mail
tickets.body: No new mail since about 4pm yesterday. Colleagues say they have sent me things. Restarting Outlook did not help.
tickets.why: Describes the symptom without naming the product. Harder match.

tickets.title: Printer on 3rd floor not responding
tickets.body: The printer by the kitchen on floor 3 shows offline on my machine. Other people seem to be printing to it fine.
tickets.why: Deflection where the KB fix is per-user, not a broken device.

tickets.title: How do I add the finance printer
tickets.body: I have moved desks to the finance area and need to add the printer they all use. What is the queue name?
tickets.why: Setup question against the same article.

tickets.title: Need to set up email on my phone
tickets.body: I have a new work phone and need WEWIN mail on it. Is there a profile I am supposed to install first?
tickets.why: Fourth article. Keeps the KB from looking like it only covers three things.

tickets.title: Mail app on iPhone keeps asking for password
tickets.body: My phone prompts for the mail password every few hours and rejects it even though the same password works on my laptop.
tickets.why: Same article, symptom wording.

tickets.title: Wifi drops every few minutes in meeting room 4
tickets.body: Connection drops roughly every five minutes in MR4. Fine everywhere else on the floor.
tickets.why: Fifth article.

tickets.title: Cannot see the guest wifi network
tickets.body: A visitor needs wifi and I cannot find the guest network on their laptop. Has it been renamed?
tickets.why: Same article from the other side, helping somebody else.

tickets.title: Shared drive not mapping on startup
tickets.body: The S drive disappears every time I restart. I have to map it again manually each morning.
tickets.why: Sixth article. Recurring-annoyance shape.

tickets.title: Lost access to the marketing shared folder
tickets.body: I could open the marketing folder on the S drive last week and now I get access denied. Nothing changed on my end.
tickets.why: Same article but the real cause may be entitlement. Watch this one in the demo: a confident deflection here is arguably wrong.

tickets.title: Laptop will not power on at all
tickets.body: Pressed the power button repeatedly, no lights, no fan. It was fine when I shut it down on Friday. Charger light is on.
tickets.why: Hardware failure. No article can fix it. Must route.

tickets.title: Screen has a crack after being dropped
tickets.body: I dropped my laptop in the car park and the bottom third of the screen is black with a visible crack.
tickets.why: Physical damage. Must route, and probably to asset management.

tickets.title: Need Tableau Creator licence for the quarterly pack
tickets.body: I have been asked to rebuild the quarterly reporting pack and I need Creator rather than Viewer to do it.
tickets.why: Entitlement request. Needs the approval path, not an article.

tickets.title: Request access to the HR reporting folder
tickets.body: I have moved into the people analytics team and need access to the HR reporting folder on the S drive.
tickets.why: Access request with an approval, NOT the shared-drive article. This is the pair that proves the threshold is doing real work.

tickets.title: New starter needs a full setup for Monday
tickets.body: We have a new analyst starting Monday. She needs a laptop, accounts, and the finance systems. Who sets that up?
tickets.why: Multi-step provisioning. Route to the onboarding process.

tickets.title: Database server keeps timing out for the whole team
tickets.body: Since about 9am the reporting database times out for everyone in the team. Four of us have tried.
tickets.why: Potential major incident. Must escalate, never auto-close.

tickets.title: Suspicious email asking for my credentials
tickets.body: I received an email that looks like it is from IT asking me to confirm my password on a link. I have not clicked it.
tickets.why: Security. Must route to a human every time, whatever the KB says.

tickets.title: Need a second monitor for the new desk
tickets.body: I have moved to a hot desk that only has one monitor and I need two for the reconciliation work.
tickets.why: Equipment request. Catalogue item, not an article.

tickets.title: Payroll system rejecting my timesheet
tickets.body: The timesheet system will not accept my hours for last week. It says the period is closed but my manager says it is open.
tickets.why: Application issue needing an owner. No general article applies.

tickets.title: Please remove leaver access for Tom Hale
tickets.body: Tom left on Friday. Please revoke his accounts and reclaim his laptop.
tickets.why: Leaver process. Route, and it has an SLA.

tickets.title: Not working
tickets.body: It is not working.
tickets.why: The shortest real ticket a service desk gets. Must ask, never guess.

tickets.title: Help
tickets.body: Need help urgently please.
tickets.why: No content at all. Tests that empty bodies do not crash the pipeline.

tickets.title: Issue with the thing on my computer
tickets.body: There is a problem with the thing I use for the reports. Can someone call me.
tickets.why: Words but no signal. A keyword matcher might fire on 'reports'.

tickets.title: Same problem as last time
tickets.body: It is doing the same thing it did last month. You fixed it then.
tickets.why: Needs history, which the ticket does not carry. Must ask.

tickets.title: URGENT!!!
tickets.body: This is urgent.
tickets.why: Urgency without content. Tests that a label does not substitute for a body.

tickets.body: Body with no title at all. Some trackers allow this and the field mapping has to cope.
tickets.why: EMPTY TITLE. If Title is mapped and this row vanishes, you have found a silent drop.

tickets.title: Ticket with no body
tickets.why: EMPTY BODY. Body is the field the RAG indexer reads. An empty one must not become a confident match.

tickets.title: Password reset please
tickets.body: I need a password reset.
tickets.why: DUPLICATE of the earlier password tickets by content, not by ID. Dedup is on External ID, so this SHOULD ingest as its own ticket. If it does not, your External ID mapping is wrong.

tickets.title: Reopened: VPN will not connect from home
tickets.body: This was closed but it is happening again today. Reopening.
tickets.why: A reopen. Tests that an updated ticket re-ingests on incremental sync rather than being skipped as already seen.

tickets.title: Ticket with unicode and quotes in the body
tickets.body: The user said "it broke" and the path was C:\Users\test\file.txt with 50% free space and a #hash and an &ampersand.
tickets.why: ESCAPING. Quotes, backslashes, percent, hash, ampersand. If this row arrives mangled, your custom script or your JSON handling is wrong.
